messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed across rtf-serving region us-west-2. Error rate spike starts ~1734567600, aggregated 5xx = 12% over baseline. Auto-run: health-check/initial-mitigation. Paging on-call.
eric (oncall): On it. I'm pulling up dashboards. Which service is the primary offender?
maria (eng-runtime): Looks like a KV/prefix cache layer between gateway and model-serving is showing a lot of cache-miss spikes and eviction churn. Latency to KV-store also spiking (~350ms p95).
liz (prod-support): Customer reports: several API calls returning 502/504 intermittently. One customer (acme-corp) saw a surge in failures on their flows. Logging correlation attached to ticket #INC-921.
eric (oncall): Handoff: eric is pager. Maria, can you join live debug? Oliver, can you confirm customer impact level?
oliver (customer-sre): Confirmed: acme saw 30% of requests failing for ~5m window; they downgraded to emergency fallback. Severity: P1 for support.
maria (eng-runtime): Joining. Quick checks: KV eviction rate (evictions/s) is 1800 (norm ~40). We have frequent checksum mismatch logs on shard-17: `kv.verify: checksum mismatch detected` followed by local eviction. Suspect memory pressure + bad eviction policy interaction.
mike (eng-ml): Any recent rollouts or quantization jobs that touch model cache keys?
maria (eng-runtime): No model code changes in the last 6h. There's an autoscaler change rolled out to cache-sidecar yesterday that may have changed target memory thresholds.
eric (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) throttle client write-heavy traffic to the cache to reduce eviction churn. 2) enable degraded routing to fallback model-variant (lighter mem footprint) for high-latency paths. 3) if checksum mismatches persist, temporarily bypass prefix cache for affected shard range.
liz (prod-support): Informing acme-corp: "We're investigating elevated 5xxs caused by internal cache instability. Short-term mitigations in progress, will update in 10m."
maria (eng-runtime): Running commands now:
```
# drain incoming cache-writes from frontends
kubectl -n infra scale deployment cache-ingress --replicas=1
# adjust eviction thresholds
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/cache-sidecar -- sh -c "echo 0.85 > /proc/cache/evict_threshold"
```
mike (eng-ml): Recommending enabling model fallback policy: `route.policy=fallback:variant-small` for routes with p50>200ms.
eric (oncall): Applying fallback routing for customer-facing routes now.
deploy-bot: deploy 1734567901 started by eric (oncall).
maria (eng-runtime): After throttle, eviction rate dropped to 120/s, KV latency fell to ~60ms p95. But checksum mismatch logs still appear ~1/min on shard-17.
oliver (customer-sre): Acme reports errors reduced dramatically to ~3% after throttle. They re-enabled normal flow for a subset and watching.
eric (oncall): Next: bypass prefix cache for shard-17 range to eliminate checksum path. Maria, can you issue bypass toggle? Add guarding flag so we don't evict others.
maria (eng-runtime): Toggling bypass for shard-17:
```
POST https://controlplane.internal/cache/bypass
payload: {"shard":"shard-17","enable":true}
```
maria (eng-runtime): Bypass applied. Observability: `kv.verify` errors stopped within 30s, p50 latency improved. No additional checksum logs.
mike (eng-ml): Suggest follow-up: collect a heap profile of sidecar instances and run a simulated write-heavy workload offline to reproduce. Also audit the autoscaler config rolled yesterday.
eric (oncall): Good. Rolling mitigation summary to incident timeline: throttled cache-writes, enabled fallback routing, bypassed problematic shard prefix cache; main customer impact reduced from 30% failures -> 3% and recovering.
liz (prod-support): Notifying acme with status update and ETA for full recovery: "We're seeing steady reduction in errors; next update in 30m. A post-incident RCA will follow." :thumbsup:
maria (eng-runtime): Action items: 1) capture sidecar heap/profile + core dumps for shard-17. 2) revert autoscaler change or tune thresholds. 3) plan for one-off repair to verify/repair corrupted keys (if any).
eric (oncall): Handing over to daytime oncall (maria will lead the mitigation/analysis). I'll remain reachable for escalation.
incident-bot: Handoff recorded: pager eric -> maria at 1734568400.
maria (eng-runtime): Adding logs for RCA: `grep -A3 checksum shard-17.log | tail -n 50` produced repeated pattern where `verify failure` followed by immediate `evict(key=...)` then `evict backlog grows`. Suspect race between verify and background compaction.
mike (eng-ml): Also, check if prefix-cache uses stale serialization after sidecar update. Could be CRC algorithm mismatch if build changed.
maria (eng-runtime): We pulled sidecar image digest: `sha256:abc123` corresponds to yesterday's rollout. Rolling back sidecar to previous digest `sha256:9f4d2` for shard nodes now.
deploy-bot: rollback 1734567940 initiated by maria.
maria (eng-runtime): Post-rollback metrics: no checksum errors for 20m, eviction rates stable ~30/s, overall 5xx back to baseline.
eric (oncall): Closing live mitigation. Maria will own RCA and follow-ups. If anyone finds customer-impact residuals, ping this thread.
liz (prod-support): Final customer update sent. Closing incident for now but keeping postmortem ticket open.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Reduced 5xx to baseline and KV stats normalized. Incident duration ~18m. Links: dashboard://incidents/1734567890, ticket://INC-921
